title: Hotels Near Yanhee International Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 7 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to Yanhee International Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Yanhee, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to Yanhee, with real distances and prices.
intro: Yanhee sits on Charan Sanitwong Road in Bang Phlat on the Thonburi side, near MRT Bang Phlat. People who come here for cosmetic or other surgery usually need to recover in Bangkok for several days to a few weeks, so the places nearby lean toward small hotels and serviced apartments in the few-hundred-to-low-thousand baht range rather than big chains. The hospital itself has its own inpatient rooms at several levels (including river-view ones), but those are admission rooms for in-patient care, not regular rooms you book on a hotel site. Below are real, bookable places, sorted closest-and-cheapest to priciest, each with its distance to Yanhee.

blocks.html: Short answer: Most Yanhee patients facing a multi-day recovery stay along Charan Sanitwong Road on the Bang Phlat side, a 5–15 minute walk or short ride from the hospital. For the closest option you can walk, pick H-Banaat (about 100 m from the hospital). For a longer stay with a small kitchen, look at BeWish Residence or The Tree Rio. If you want a pool and a bigger room, go for Beyond Suite or the riverside WE Hotel Riverfront.

blocks.text: Hotels near Yanhee, by distance & budget

items.name: BeWish Residence Bangphlat
items.meta: 📍 4-min drive (600 m) to Yanhee · ★ 3-star · Best for: Long budget stays · in-room microwave & fridge · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small serviced apartment on Soi Charan Sanitwong 84, about 600 m from Yanhee. Part of the building is rented monthly and part runs as a daily hotel. Rooms come with a microwave, fridge, kettle and a balcony, which suits a multi-day recovery when you want to heat your own food. It's the cheapest starting price in the area; check for a lift and a convenient floor if you've just had surgery.

items.name: The Tree Rio Bang-Aor
items.meta: 📍 3-min drive (400 m) · next to MRT Bang O to Yanhee · ★ 3-star · Best for: Long stays · studio with kitchenette + pool · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer condo right by MRT Bang O station, about 400 m from Yanhee, with several units listed for daily and monthly stays on Agoda. They're furnished studios with a kitchenette, a washing machine in some, and a shared pool. Good for a longer recovery if you want a home-like space and easy train access. Since each unit has a different owner, read the reviews for the specific room and check the floor and lift before booking.

items.name: H-Banaat Hotel
items.meta: 📍 2-min walk (100 m) to Yanhee · ★ 3-star · Best for: Closest, walkable · early appointments & short recovery · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small, recently opened hotel with a few dozen rooms on Soi Charan Sanitwong 92, around 100 m from Yanhee — close enough to walk to the hospital easily. That's the main draw if you have an early surgery slot or need daily dressing changes. Rooms are clean with air-con and a TV, and patient reviews rate the location highly, though there's no pool and no breakfast. A convenience store and street stalls are nearby.

items.name: P-Park Hotel
items.meta: 📍 5-min drive (700 m) to Yanhee · ★ 3-star · Best for: Want a pool & gym · monthly option available · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 60-room hotel in Bang Phlat, about 700 m from Yanhee, with a pool, gym and parking. Rooms have a mini-fridge and tea/coffee gear. The same group also runs P-Park Residence with monthly rates for longer recoveries. A good fit if you want more facilities than a small hotel; at 700 m a taxi or motorbike taxi reaches Yanhee in a few minutes.

items.name: Beyond Suite Hotel
items.meta: 📍 5-min drive (700 m) to Yanhee · ★ 4-star · Best for: Spacious rooms · indoor pool · comfortable recovery · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 75-room 4-star hotel on Charan Sanitwong 85, about 700 m from Yanhee (some sites still list its old name, The Luxury Suite). It has an indoor pool, parking and large, modern rooms. Many patients pick it for recovery because the rooms are roomy and a taxi to the hospital is easy. One thing reviews flag: room service and the kitchen keep set hours, so late-night food can be hard to get — keep some supplies on hand if you're eating on your own schedule after surgery.

items.name: Peya Rama-7
items.meta: 📍 8-min drive (1.2 km) to Yanhee · ★ 3-star · Best for: Quiet riverside · calm recovery · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel on the Chao Phraya near the Rama 7 Bridge, about 1.2 km from Yanhee on the quieter Bang Kruai side. Rooms have air-con, en-suite bathrooms and fast internet. It suits anyone who'd rather recover somewhere calm by the water than on a busy main road; it's not walkable to Yanhee but a taxi is only a few minutes. Note the check-in window, as the front desk keeps set hours.

items.name: WE Hotel Riverfront
items.meta: 📍 7-min drive (1.1 km) to Yanhee · ★ 4-star · Best for: Riverside garden & pool · most restful recovery · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star hotel by the Chao Phraya on Soi Charan Sanitwong 96/2 in the Bang O area, about 1.1 km from Yanhee. It has a garden, an outdoor pool, a restaurant and free parking, tucked into a quiet riverside corner. Reviews praise the comfortable beds and the peaceful setting. A good pick for a longer, quieter recovery if you don't need to walk to the hospital — getting around is easiest by taxi or a ride-hailing app.

faq.q: What's the closest place to Yanhee that I can walk to?
faq.a: H-Banaat Hotel is the closest, about 100 m from Yanhee — a 2-minute walk to a hospital entrance. It's ideal for an early surgery slot or daily dressing changes. It's a small hotel with only a few dozen rooms and fills fast with patients, so book ahead on Agoda, Booking or Trip.com. If it's full, the next options at 400–700 m are The Tree Rio, BeWish Residence, P-Park and Beyond Suite, all a few minutes from Yanhee by taxi or motorbike taxi.

faq.q: For a multi-week recovery, where has rooms with a kitchen or monthly rates?
faq.a: For a long recovery where you want to heat your own food, look at serviced apartments like BeWish Residence (microwave and fridge) or a studio at The Tree Rio with a kitchenette and a washing machine in some units. P-Park also has a sister property, P-Park Residence, that rents monthly. Monthly rates for apartments in this area start in the low thousands of baht and are far cheaper than booking nightly for weeks. It's best to message the property directly for a weekly or monthly rate, and check for a lift and a convenient floor if you've just had surgery.

faq.q: How do I get from the airport to Yanhee and the hotels in this area?
faq.a: From Suvarnabhumi or Don Muang, the easiest way after surgery is a taxi or ride-hailing app straight to Bang Phlat, about 45–60 minutes depending on traffic. A taxi from Suvarnabhumi runs roughly 350–450 baht including tolls, and from Don Muang about 250–350 baht. If you're up to it and travelling light, the train works too — the MRT Blue Line has Bang Phlat and Bang O stations near the hospital and several of these hotels — but right after surgery a door-to-door taxi is more comfortable. Many hotels here can call a taxi for you.
